theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Xs : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U k) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (ξs : ℕ → Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (μX μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξX : Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (t : ℝ), IsOpen U → Continuous f → WeaklyConvergesOn Xs X → (∀ j, ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μs j K < ∞) → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (ξs j) (μs j)) → (∀ j, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μs j), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξs j x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ j, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Xs j ω = ∫ x, ξs j x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂(μs j)) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μX K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξX μX → (∀ᵐ x ∂μX, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξX x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, X ω = ∫ x, ξX x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μX) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → limsup (fun j => μs j K) atTop ≤ μ K) → μ {x | f x = t} = 0 → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξs j x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂(μs j)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξX x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μX))
